searchText: **Implementers' Call in 10 minutes** **Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/226** **Zoom: https://consensys.zoom.us/j/92426301194 ** <@!213672586264051717> I don't think I have heard anyone discuss that particular solution (1559 transactions included first, legacy transactions fill remaining "space"). My gut says it is going to end up being really complex and weird, but I would be curious to hear a more complete proposal on it if someone is passionate about pursuing the solution. What gets weird is that "remaining space" in 1559 doesn't mean the same thing as it does in legacy transaction world. <@!543900561460822016> may be interested in exploring that, since I know they really wanted to get the fixed `miner_bribe` thing working (though, not sure you still feel that way). Or, someone may be able to just mention me in 12 hours and get a much better answer. 😬 I think <@!415548822983278593> has brought me over to the dynamic tip side Due to the "cliff" argument? That was a new argument to me (or perhaps, just new to tired me) and I found it compelling when I heard it just now. I apologize again for my behavior in the call. I must be really out of it. 😖. Also for my poor internet connection. I have not noticed at all a bad behavior. The only issue was about your audio. And please, take time to rest. I kept piping up with something to say and then forgetting my point before I finished. Also, I was a little overenthusiastic on one of my points. Not composed like someone wearing a bowtie should be. Yeah, managing the order of transactions at the consensus level seems pretty complex. So, to summarize the next steps from today's call: 1️⃣ Try and come up with a roadmap to mainnet, and gather feedback on the next call; 2️⃣ Get other clients running the large-state testnet that Abdel generated, and run the transaction spammer tool on it to see the impact of 2x sized blocks on clients when the state size is comparable to mainnet 3️⃣ Try and come up with good heuristics for transaction sorting for both miners and other nodes 4️⃣ Wait and see what happens with 2718 getting merged in Geth I've added the above to the agenda for the next call: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/229. I've just a cal invite as well. If anyone wants to be added, DM me your email 😄

2️⃣ Get other clients running the large-state testnet that Abdel generated, and run the transaction spammer tool on it to see the impact of 2x sized blocks on clients when the state size is comparable to mainnet
3️⃣ Try and come up with good heuristics for transaction sorting for both miners and other nodes
4️⃣ Wait and see what happens with 2718 getting merged in Geth 

I've added the above to the agenda for the next call: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/229. I've just a cal invite as well. If anyone wants to be added, DM me your email 😄
